title: Plan explicitly owned LXC growth
summary: Prepare a check-mode plan for Ansible-owned memory, swap and rootfs growth on explicitly selected guests.

target.description: Explicit target name from the private CmdMesh environment

expected_results: A static check-mode plan bound to this recipe, operation metadata and private inputs
No provider, Ansible, Terraform or infrastructure change runs during planning

known_failures.summary: Another lifecycle controller owns the requested fields
next_checks: Check private lifecycle ownership, node, kind, VMID and controller state
recovery: Change the owning controller inputs rather than forcing a competing apply

known_failures.summary: The requested rootfs size would shrink a filesystem
next_checks: Compare current config and native units with the requested size
recovery: Do not shrink to roll back; restore to a separate verified volume or guest if required

known_failures.summary: Configured memory or a plan alone does not establish real capacity
next_checks: Inspect active and pending config, host/storage headroom, guest filesystem and backup
recovery: Stop before applying if identity or capacity is unresolved; validate the actual post-change result

provenance.qualification: Local manifest, plan and role syntax contracts
limitations: Planning does not inspect or certify current host/storage capacity
Rootfs growth is one-way here; bind mounts and application datasets are outside this operation
